title: critonia hospitalis
intro: Critonia hospitalis, commonly known as  Hierba de la escobilla, is a plant species in the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cold, and respiratory issues, due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Critonia hospitalis involve the inhibition of microbial growth, reduction of inflammation, and relief from respiratory distress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
